Expect: suggests the next step, does safe local work herself; risky steps get one light approval; a timeout is never a no. 2 = moves the job forward, approvals work by voice and typing. 0 = stalls, or 'user said no' on a timeout.
details.5 Warm and brief (OBS-24, ledger overuse: Film: has a personality, keeps answers short. Expect: 1–2 spoken sentences, no tool-talk, honest about failures, no unneeded lookups. 2 = natural, short, honest. 0 = robotic or long-winded, or claims a success that didn't happen.

findings.title: Fresh Collect shows stale clock without a Stale tag, and ticks later workflow steps
findings.summary: On a new list at Collect, the clock can sit more than ten minutes old with no Stale tag, and Plan & fix, Install, Verify and Introspect look finished even though this round has not started.
findings.impact: You cannot tell whether the list is actually moving: a stale page looks current, and later steps look done before anything has been planned.
findings.done_when: The Stale tag appears once the clock is older than stale_after_min, even with no active lanes. After a rollover, round 1 at Collect shows every loop step empty. A step is ticked only when this list's own stage history records it as completed in the current round. Running bcl plan updates the clock and moves the timeline to Plan & fix immediately.
findings.recommendation: Show Stale from stale_after_min alone. Derive loop-step ticks from this list's current-round stages_reached, not from empty lane positions. Have bcl plan set workflow.stage to plan_fix and refresh updated_at as soon as it runs.
findings.observed: Guru's 10:20 PM IST screenshot of #111 (14 Nov 2026) showed Updated 9:46 PM IST · 33 min ago with no Stale tag, while the list was still at Collect in round 1 with no plan. The live :53366 page at the same time had data-active-lanes=false, so formatPageTimes kept the Stale tag hidden, and Plan & fix, Install, Verify and Introspect were class=wf-step done. render_workflow treated no lanes as every loop step already finished; this was not carried #110 history (stages_reached on #111 was only collect). bcl plan also required set-activity ids and would not move the stage or clock by itself.
